name: weathergpt-monorepo
description: WeatherGPT — Conversational AI for Weather Forecasting, Alerts, and Climate Information (SIH26068)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
